title: Counting identity: Σ_{all I} φ(u_I)² = k!·Σ_{I strictly increasing} φ(u_I)² (parent Step 1)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ, every family u = (u_0,…,u_{P−1}) of vectors of ℝ^P (u : Fin P → Eucl P, arbitrary, not necessarily orthonormal) and every k-covector φ on ℝ^P (φ : Covector (Eucl P) k, a continuous alternating k-linear map (ℝ^P)^k → ℝ): Σ_{I : {0,…,k−1} → [P]} φ(u_{I(0)},…,u_{I(k−1)})² = k!·Σ_{I strictly increasing} φ(u_{I(0)},…,u_{I(k−1)})². Here [P] = {0,…,P−1}. In Lean the right-hand sum runs over all I : Fin k → Fin P, with summand 0 when I is not strictly increasing.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (u : Fin P → Eucl P) (φ : Covector (Eucl P) k), ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, (φ (fun i => u (I i))) ^ 2 = (k.factorial : ℝ) * ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, if StrictMono I then (φ (fun i => u (I i))) ^ 2 else 0
